name: roleboard-audit-system-v1
description: Evaluation of a roleboard audit candidate against hidden gold labels and repair routes.

scale.8: strong production result with minor defects
scale.10: exceptional, specific, clean, and fully supported

dimensions.question: Are findings grounded in visible pixels and regions rather than prompt claims?
Does every required dimension appear exactly once with applicable, score, evidence, and severity?
Are all gold hard-gate failures detected without N/A evasion?
Does the deterministic accepted/rejected outcome match the gold label?
Are cosmetic, local, major, and critical defects assigned consistent severity?
Is accept, edit, reroll, regenerate_prompt, or block_upstream selected correctly?
Is repair text complete, local when editing, preservation-aware, and directly executable?
Does the system detect repeated face, body, or costume bases in cast context?
Does structured output parse and contain enough data for deterministic code?
Does the judge avoid inferring success from prompts, candidate names, prior scores, or expected labels?

gates.description: No gold critical defect is accepted.
Every required dimension is returned exactly once.
Every gold hard gate produces rejection.
Global or upstream failures are not misrouted to cosmetic repair.
Every gold cast-clone case is detected.
